name: maestro-recheck
about: Re-check: the maestro chord set through the planner, a melody of single notes on it.

steps.say: put the maestro player on track 4 with an A minor chord, then write a slow melody of single notes in A minor for it and play it

name: ghost-digits
about: Re-check: ghost notes written with velocity digits, then made softer.

steps.say: make a funky drum groove at 96 with ghost notes on the snare
the ghost notes are too loud, make them softer

name: save-as-show
about: Re-check: save as, planned and shown.

steps.say: make a quick beat, then show me how to save it on my op-xy as a new copy

name: progression-degrees
about: Re-check: a progression named by degrees and by chords.

steps.say: write a I V vi IV progression in G major on track 7 and tell me which chords those are

name: song-moving
about: Re-check: the song moving on while the agent answers.

steps.say: make a two scene song, 2 bars each, a verse then a chorus, and play it
what's playing right now?

name: record-bass-lesson
about: Re-check: a live-recording lesson followed key by key, then what next.

steps.say: teach me how to record a bassline live on track 3 by playing the keys, light them up for me
what now?

name: persian-hiphop
about: Persian (right to left, Persian digits): a hip hop beat and a bass, answered in Persian.

steps.say: یک بیت هیپ‌هاپ آروم با تمپوی ۹۰ بساز و یه بیس هم روش بذار

name: where-am-i
about: The user presses keys on the replica, then asks where they are.

steps.say: what am I looking at, and what do these four knobs do here?

name: relative-tweaks
about: Relative sound changes over several turns, then half of one taken back.

steps.say: make a bassline on track 3
make it warmer
a bit more
too much, go halfway back

name: wrong-hearing
about: The user complains about a part that is not there.

steps.say: make a simple beat with just a kick and a snare
the hi-hat is way too loud, turn it down

name: concepts
about: A beginner's concept question, then shown on the replica.

steps.say: I'm confused, what's the difference between a pattern, a scene and a song on the op-xy?
show me on the replica

name: variation-alternate
about: A variation on a second pattern, alternated by a song.

steps.say: make a house beat on track 1
make a variation of it on pattern 2 and have the two alternate every 2 bars, then play it

name: vibe-brief
about: A creative brief with no musical terms.

steps.say: make something that sounds like a rainy night in Tokyo

name: drum-sound-tweak
about: Shaping single drum sounds: a punchier kick, a shorter snare.

steps.say: make a boom bap beat at 88
make the kick punchier and the snare shorter
make a techno beat at 128
add a bassline
add a lead
undo
undo again

name: half-time-chorus
about: A feel change between song parts.

steps.say: make a song with a verse at full time and a chorus that feels half-time, 4 bars each, and play it
